action: Do not rely on blocking a few big groups: patch internet-facing systems and enforce MFA on remote access, and check whether your sector or suppliers appear in leak-site listings.
actor: Qilin; The Gentlemen; INC Ransom; Akira; DragonForce
exec: Ransomware claims hit a record in Q3 and are spreading across many more groups, so defending against a few big names no longer covers the risk.
plain: Security firm Check Point counted a record 2,830 ransomware victims named by attackers in the third quarter of 2026, spread across more groups than before.

key_findings: 2,830 victims published in Q3 2026, described as a record (July 964, August 1,042, September 824).
117 ransomware brands claimed victims, up from 91 in Q2; 42 first appeared in Q3.
Top ten groups' share of victims fell from 71% (Q1) to 58% (Q2) to 49% (Q3).
Qilin had 366 victims (about 13%) and The Gentlemen 339 (about 12%); LockBit fell out of the top ten.
United States 42% of victims; Business Services the largest sector at 34%.

summary: Check Point reports a record 2,830 ransomware victims published in Q3 2026, based on leak-site claims. 117 brands claimed victims, up from 91, and the top ten groups' share fell to 49% from 71% in Q1. Qilin and The Gentlemen led. The United States made up 42% of victims and Business Services 34%.
title: Check Point counts record 2,830 ransomware victims in Q3 2026

validation.note: Read the original Check Point report; counts are leak-site claims, a single vendor's data.

review.note: Check Point report: 2,830 victims, monthly figures, 117 vs 91 brands, 49/58/71% top ten, Qilin 366, Gentlemen 339, US 42%, Business Services 34%, INC/Akira/DragonForce top-ten all match
